_doc: Day events (port of the Godot Economy.DAY_EVENTS): one event per day, decided the night before so the phone can forecast it. Parties follow the weekly calendar (day % 7) from party_from_day; the carnaval needs the mayor's chapter. Random events by odds. demand multiplies the kiosk arrivals (deco = with the paid preparations). Paid preparations: decoration for a party, storm protection for a storm (otherwise storm_loss of the supplies is lost). Sea tours are cancelled on rough_sea events. party_spot = centre of the party on the beach [x, y, yaw] in world cm. Seasons cycle every sum(days) days from day 1; each multiplies the kiosk arrivals (demand) and sets the chance of a rainy day (rain_odds).

end_of_content.title: Obrigado por jogar o Acesso Antecipado!
end_of_content.text: Você transformou o quiosque da avó Dilce num resort inteiro. O Maré Alta continua crescendo: novas expansões, a ilha do passeio de barco, temporadas e muito mais chegam nas próximas atualizações. Pode continuar jogando: o resort segue aberto.
